author: Grace Turney
title: 4 Zodiac Signs Who Are Vicious Verbal Assassins
text:
Is there someone in your life you don’t dare cross because you know they could annihilate you with their words?
They probably belong to one of the zodiacs who are the most vicious verbal assassins. They’re quick-thinking, sharp-tongued, and can cut you to ribbons with their harsh words. Here are the four star signs who are masters of verbal insults, and how astrology explains their stinging speech.
Aries Aries is one of the last zodiacs you should ever try to beat in a verbal disagreement. Aries is ruled by Mars, the planet of war, passion, and aggression. This means that Aries people are fighters in every sense – they never back down from an argument and they are the first to stand up for themselves (or their loved ones). While some zodiacs go out of their way to avoid confrontation, Aries runs to it. They are also very impulsive and honest; they can’t stand liars and you can always trust them to tell you the truth. Unfortunately, they can be a bit harsh and tactless, and their honesty may come off as unkindness. Even when they’re not trying to start a fight, they can be a bit abrasive and hard to take. Another reason Aries people are verbal assassins is their mental power. Aries rules the head, including the brain, which means that this zodiac sign is very smart. They are quick-thinking and know how to use words as a weapon. Yes, you should definitely avoid any verbal sparring with this star sign, because you will lose and get torn to pieces in the process.
Gemini You do not want to tango with a Gemini because these wordsmiths will have you begging them to quit their tongue-lashing. Geminis are gifted with strong language skills because their zodiac sign is ruled by Mercury, the planet of communication and intellect. Thanks to Mercury’s influence, Geminis are not only highly intelligent, but they are also masters of verbal expression. Many Geminis make excellent writers, public speakers, rappers, or teachers. They also make a formidable opponent in a war of words, and it’s much better to have them on your side than against you. Geminis are generally kind-hearted and fun-loving, so it’s not in their nature to pick fights. But they will end arguments with their harsh, brilliant words if someone incites their wrath. They love to amuse themselves and make people laugh, so one of their go-to tricks in an argument is making you the butt of the joke. Do not insult a Gemini unless you’re prepared to be dressed down and humiliated.
Virgo Virgo is another star sign you don’t want to mess with because, like Gemini, Virgo is guided by Mercury. This planet blesses Virgo with the same gifts of intellect and communication, but as an earth sign, Virgo wields these weapons a little differently. Earth signs are very focused on logic and facts. A Virgo won’t care how much their words hurt you if what they’re saying is true. They are the perfectionists of the zodiac, always spotting flaws and things they want to fix in others and their surroundings. When they share their criticisms, it often comes off as unkindness, even when they’re just trying to help. So imagine how cruel they can be when they hold nothing back and their intention is to hurt you. No one’s words sting quite like a Virgo’s because there is always at least a shred of truth to what they say. It’s not easy to brush off their insults when you believe them, especially when they prey on your insecurities. You’ve been warned – don’t upset a Virgo unless you want to get your feelings brutally, deeply hurt.
Sagittarius Sagittarius is the final zodiac you should never try to defeat in a war of words. As a fire sign, Sagittarians are impulsive and reckless, which means they can also be a bit tactless at times. They say whatever is on their mind, and they have no filter. Sometimes their honesty can come across as cruelty, even when they think they’re just making a joke or a casual observation. They’re so resilient that insults slide off them, and they expect everyone else to be the same. And they’re usually fun-loving and good-hearted, so their insults are typically accidental. But when they’re mad, they unleash the full power of their wrath. Nothing can prepare you for the way they will rip you to shreds from top to bottom. And once they’re done, they move on and forget about it as quickly as it happened, leaving you to lick your wounds.
